content_notes: Every claim in this pack is about the cb.pack contract as implemented in this repository (contracts/pack-manifest.v1.json, contracts/pack-manifest.v2.json, contracts/vocabulary.v1.json, coursebook/archive.py). It links no external source and quotes no third-party text.
The pack claims no human review and no native-speaker or expert review: its checks are recorded audit_state "unreviewed", which is the fact the second section teaches.
This course is about the pack format. It teaches the pack format, not the subject of any other pack.

2.0.0 added one composed Press Plate cover (content/cover-16x9.png with its 3:2 crop) and moved the document to cb.pack v2 so the plate could be linked through media[]. The plate was decorative: it was not a diagram of the manifest schema and stated no field, count or rule.

2.1.0 replaces the Press Plate cover with the approved painted plate for this pack (content/cover-3x2.png, 1200x800, and its exact 4:5 centre crop content/cover-4x5.png) as role 'cover'. The plate is model output generated for this pack; its provenance and rights position (CC-BY-4.0 under the operator-directed redistribution of 2026-11-10) are recorded per artifact. Its pages are blank: it states no field, count or rule, and no lesson depends on seeing it.

2.2.0 rewrites three learner-facing phrases that read as if this repository's own packs were throwaway exhibit material — in the anatomy section, the label section and content/source-notes.md — as the pack-contract rule they teach: a pack may declare `unspecified`/`local_only`, a `human_review_recorded` fact is absent when no review is on record, and `audit_state: "unreviewed"` is the honest default for any unreviewed check. No contract fact, check or citation changed.

2.3.0 replaces the model-painted cover with deterministic, text-free art printed by the pack builder from flat geometry (CC0-1.0), because the image model bakes garbled lettering into plates. The image carries no glyph; the course title is UI text. The pack licence note now states that deterministic provenance instead of calling the cover model output. No contract fact, check or citation changed.
